summary: Staff members meet individual legislators while their leader works with the floor managers.
realLife: Dirksen conferred with Humphrey or Kuchel while staff negotiated with individual Republican senators.
gates: A revised bill needs support inside a divided caucus.
inGame: needs: staff conversations tied to individual members' stated reservations about a bill version.

turns.what: A member gives staff a question for counsel and withholds a position.
turns.pulledBy: The answer turns on how one provision will be administered.
turns.writesBack: The tally records an open question beside the member's name.

turns.what: A member calls staff back after reading the revision.
turns.pulledBy: The new language resolves the objection raised in the first conversation.
turns.writesBack: The second conversation updates the member's recorded position.
